title: Understanding SVD and Variance
text: In Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), the singular values in matrix S represent the importance of each principal component. The variance captured by each component is proportional to the square of its singular value.

title: Calculating Total Variance
text: To find the total variance, you need to sum the squares of all singular values. This will give you the denominator for calculating the proportion of variance captured by each component.
